leadText: Radley (Japanese: ラウル Raul) is a character of the day who appeared in Curtain Up, Unova League!. He participated in the Vertress Conference and was Stephan's first opponent. However, he was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament.
plainText:
Radley (Japanese: ラウル Raul) is a character of the day who appeared in Curtain Up, Unova League!. He participated in the Vertress Conference and was Stephan's first opponent. However, he was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament.
